POSITION PURPOSE/MISSION:


As a P&C Insurance Claims Expert, you serve as the vital connection between our company and our

customers. The primary goal of this role is to ensure that our clients reach their desired outcomes

through the successful use and adoption of our software solutions. By cultivating trusted relationships, proactively guiding clients, and offering expert support, you directly contribute to their satisfaction, loyalty, and long-term success. This role is essential to ensuring that our customers see measurable value, continue their partnership with us, and are well-positioned to expand their use of our offerings.


Your ability to manage customer expectations, resolve issues efficiently, and provide actionable insights will play a key part in building strong, ongoing relationships. This position also requires an in-depth understanding of SaaS solutions and insurance operations, as well as a collaborative mindset suited for working in a globally distributed, remote-first team environment.


This role will have secondary responsibilities to assist with pre-sales activities including but not limited to: gather, understand and translate customer’s technical requirements, bridge communications between technical and non-technical teams, assist or conduct product demos, create technical documentation, assist or complete RFP’s, support FRISS’ implementation teams & other potential duties.



DESCRIPTION OF ACTIVITIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:


  • Customer Relationship Management

Build and nurture strong, long-term relationships with customers by serving as their trusted

advisor. Regularly check in with key stakeholders to understand their experience and align on

expectations and needs.


  • Proactive Engagement

Maintain regular contact with customers through scheduled calls, emails, and success planning

sessions. Ensure that their goals are defined and met, anticipate challenges, and propose

proactive solutions to maximize satisfaction.


  • Performance Monitoring

Continuously monitor customer usage, health scores, and performance data to assess how the

product is delivering value. Use insights to identify areas of concern or opportunity and

intervene early when needed.


  • Product Enhancements

Collect feedback from customer interactions and communicate relevant insights to the product

development team. Help inform future product enhancements by representing the voice of the

customer.


  • Renewals and Upselling

Take ownership of contract renewals, maintaining strong relationships that support ongoing engagement. Identify and pursue upsell opportunities where additional features or services can deliver added value to the customer.


  • Customer Training

Support new customers during onboarding by guiding them through our processes and helping them become self-sufficient. Provide training and support to ensure they can use our software confidently and effectively.


  • Internal Collaboration

Work closely with the Professional Services & Sales team to ensure a seamless handover from pre-sale to post-sale. Provide background on customer expectations and align on strategy for long-term success. And other duties assigned.


JOB SKILLS:


Success in this role depends on both soft skills and the ability to operate effectively in a digital, global

environment.


Must Haves:

  • Insurance Expertise

Deep subject matter expertise in Insurance is a non-negotiable for this role. The CSM must be able to communicate with clients in their native language (insurance), understand their needs and deliver consultative insights aligned with FRISS’ product value


Language Skills

  • This role requires tri-lingual language skills:

Native-level Portuguese to serve clients in Brazil; fluent in Spanish to serve clients throughout LATAM; and professional working level in English to communicate within FRISS.


Nice to Haves:

  • Customer Focus and Engagement

You are passionate about helping customers succeed, and you consistently strive to understand

their needs and exceed their expectations.


  • Business & Analytical Insights

You understand how your customers operate and how to align our solutions with their business

objectives. You are analytically inclined and can demonstrate FRISS’ value through storytelling

and analytical insights.


  • Technical Proficiency

You are comfortable using CRM systems, customer success platforms, and other relevant SaaS tools to manage your workflow and customer data effectively. · Global Perspective You thrive in an international, remote-first work environment and can communicate and collaborate across geographies and cultures with ease.

With a strong presence across multiple states in the U.S. and international operations, the organization serves generations of families through a wide network of clinics and healthcare professionals. We are looking for a Senior Engineer with strong .NET expertise and hands-on AI experience. In this role, you will build and deliver cloud-native applications while actively using AI tools and integrating AI capabilities into products.


This is not a junior position. We are looking for engineers who take ownership, think critically, and deliver real impact.

  • Develop scalable applications using .NET, ASP.NET Core and Blazor

  • Design and optimize APIs and database structures

  • Blazor experience (WebAssembly and/or Server) — production experience preferred
  • Azure services: App Service, Static Web Apps, Azure Functions, Service Bus, or similar

  • SQL proficiency: query writing, indexing, and diagnosing performance issues

  • Familiarity with end-to-end testing tools such as Playwright is a plus
  • Ability to design meaningful test scenarios and prioritize quality over coverage metrics


AI-Assisted Development

  • Strong prompt writing skills and ability to guide AI effectively
  • Experience using AI for code generation, refactoring, documentation and code review
  • Ability to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure code quality
  • Keeping up to date with evolving AI tools and applying them in development workflows


Building AI-Powered Features

  • Understanding of AI-driven workflows and agent-based systems

Who You Are

  • You write clean and maintainable code
  • You take ownership and deliver end-to-end
  • You focus on building rather than discussing
  • You are curious, proactive and open to continuous learning


If you enjoy building real products and working with modern technologies, we would be happy to hear from you.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack Sênior #998061
description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.


Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?


O que procuramos?

Perfil autônomo, independente e proativo , com responsabilidade sobre as soluções do início ao fim. Experiência em linguagens Node.js , JavaScript: (ES6+), ou TypeScript , além de conhecimento em React.


O que você precisa ter?

  • Linguagens de Programação: Node.js , JavaScript: (ES6+), TypeScript
  • Frameworks e Bibliotecas: React
  • Estilos e Layouts: HTML5, CSS3
  • Familiaridade com microserviços.
  • Habilidade em gerenciamento: de APIs e MQ.
  • Experiência com: MongoDB.


Será um diferencial:

  • Desenvolvimento Backend: NestJS
  • Conhecimentos em: Angular e Vue.js, Springboot / Java, Oracle / PL/SQL
  • Entender requisitos e propusesse soluções para melhor navegação e exibição das informações necessárias.
  • Capacidade de desenhar arquitetura sistêmica e propor melhores abordagens para as telas do sistema.
  • Agnóstico a tecnologia e linguagem de programação, pois entendemos que sabendo os conceitos, não importa a ferramenta utilizada.
  • Já trabalhou com Metodologia Ágil.


O que você fará no seu dia a dia?

  • Desenvolver a evolução das soluções, sempre mantendo a escalabilidade e performance
  • Promover a qualidade através de testes.
  • Colaborar na construção dos requisitos junto ao Usuário e, em conjunto com o time, implementá-los do código até a Produção.
  • Auxiliar na construção de UI/UX das soluções da Squads.


Local de atuação? No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office.

title: Consultor de vendas
description:
Descrição da Empresa

Plataforma de carreira da nova economia com mais 10 mil alunos formados.

Somos uma empresa de educação que oferece cursos, pós graduação e mestrados

internacionais.

  • Missão: Gerar oportunidades de crescimento e mudança de vida para profissionais da área

que buscam sucesso e satisfação pessoal e financeira.


  • Visão: Ser a empresa referência no setor de educação para saúde e impactar mais

de 100.000 vidas e 5.000 profissionais


  • Valores: Clientes no centro, verdade, ambição e sentimento de melhorias.

inspirada. Nossa cultura reflete nosso compromisso em criar um ambiente de trabalho que

não apenas apoie o crescimento e o desenvolvimento profissional, mas também valorize

cada membro da equipe, acreditamos que cada colaborador tem papel essencial na

concretização da visão de impacto social da empresa. Aqui nossos colaboradores tem

possibilidade e visão de crescimento no nosso ecossistema.



Estamos contratando Consultor de Vendas para integrar nossa equipe em Salvador, BA. As principais responsabilidades incluem atender clientes, buscar clientes, identificar suas necessidades e recomendar soluções educacionais alinhadas às suas metas.   • Consultoria de Vendas: Experiência em consultoria de vendas, conhecimento em estratégias de vendas e habilidade para identificar oportunidades no mercado.

title: Product Manager - B2B | Câmbio / FX
description:
Sua carreira com liberdade e propósito

Na Remessa Online, não se trata apenas de transferências internacionais, criamos conexões que rompem fronteiras e transformam realidades. Somos movidos pela ousadia, respeito, colaboração, encantamento e responsabilidade.

Nosso segredo? Trabalhar juntos com transparência, comprometimento e autonomia, sempre buscando a melhor solução. Estamos revolucionando o cenário financeiro global, e você pode fazer parte dessa jornada conosco!


Como vai ser o seu dia a dia

Buscamos um(a) Product Manager estratégico, analítico e comunicativo, capaz de conectar produto, tecnologia e negócio para impulsionar nossas soluções. Esperamos alguém que tenha uma execução ágil e organizada, garantindo qualidade e rapidez, além de autonomia para conduzir upstream e gerenciar o backlog sem necessidade de direcionamento constante. E que possua forte capacidade analítica para tomar decisões embasadas, comunicação clara para alinhar stakeholders e um sólido senso de responsabilidade e equilíbrio na tomada de decisões.

  • Experiência com descoberta e desenvolvimento de produtos;
  • Domínio de métricas, KPIs e análise de dados para tomada de decisão;
  • Capacidade de priorizar backlog e rodar sprints com eficiência;
  • Conhecimento de estratégia de produto e roadmap;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de gestão como JIRA, Kanbanize e Confluence;
  • Noção de tecnologia e APIs para dialogar bem com times de engenharia;
  • Experiência em produtos financeiros, especialmente câmbio;
  • Histórico de atuação em ambientes dinâmicos e de alto crescimento;
  • Habilidade em negociação e influência para conectar áreas e garantir entregas estratégicas;
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência como Product Manager.


O que você precisa saber para se juntar ao nosso time

  • Experiência com setor de câmbio;
  • Atuar na plataforma Web PJ, que já existe, mas precisa de mais atração e engajamento;
  • Foco em aquisição, recorrência e fidelização de clientes PJ;
  • Explorar e fortalecer soluções para diferentes perfis de empresa (desde o \"PJtinha\" até grandes como Comex);
  • Conhecer bem a operação da Remessa para propor melhorias reais;
  • Enfrentar concorrência forte com diferenciais frente a players concorrentes da Remessa;
  • Ter visão de toda a jornada e ciclo de vida do cliente PJ;
  • Apoiar no crescimento da base com experiência em aquisição de clientes e produtos de plataforma.


O que oferecemos

  • Contrato CLT – Todos os direitos garantidos.
  • Bônus por metas – Recebimento de bônus atrelado ao cumprimento de objetivos organizacionais.
  • Plano de saúde e odontológico – Cobertura para você e seus dependentes via SulAmérica.
  • VR e VA flexíveis – Créditos no Caju para usar como quiser.
  • Auxílio Home Office – Suporte para despesas e equipamentos.
  • Seguro de Vida – Proteção e segurança para você.
  • Auxílio Creche – Apoio para mães e pais.
  • Auxílio a dependentes com necessidades especiais – Apoio financeiro dedicado.
  • Licenças Estendidas – Maternidade e paternidade ampliadas para você aproveitar esse momento especial.
  • Descontos na Remessa Online – Para viver sem fronteiras!
  • Bem-estar e saúde – Consultas online com psicólogos e nutricionistas via Conexa Saúde e Psicologia Viva.

  • Apoio ao Empregado (EAP) – Suporte especializado sempre que precisar.

title: Social Media Growth Strategist
description:
Job Title: Social Media Growth Strategist

About the Company:

Our Client is a dynamic company focused on leveraging digital platforms to drive brand engagement and growth. They specialize in creating innovative social media strategies to enhance visibility and interaction across various channels.

Job Description:

Our client is seeking a Social Media Growth Strategist to lead and execute high-performance growth initiatives for their Instagram presence. This role is focused on scaling audience growth through data-driven strategies, performance analysis, and systematic content experimentation. The ideal candidate has a proven track record of rapidly scaling Instagram accounts, understands platform algorithms deeply, and uses analytics, testing, and optimization to consistently drive follower growth and engagement.

Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute data-driven Instagram growth strategies aimed at scaling the account by 5,000+ followers per month.
  • Analyze performance metrics to continuously optimize content strategy, timing, and format.
  • Design and run content experiments (hooks, formats, topics, posting cadence) to identify scalable growth patterns.
  • Use AI tools and analytics platforms to generate insights, content ideas, and performance improvements.
  • Oversee and manage the content publishing pipeline, ensuring consistent and strategic posting.
  • Collaborate with designers, editors, and content creators to produce high-performing Reels, carousels, and short-form content.
  • Repurpose and adapt content across platforms (Instagram, X, and others) to maximize reach.
  • Monitor trends, algorithm updates, and competitive accounts to identify new growth opportunities.
  • Track KPIs and report on growth metrics, engagement rates, and audience acquisition performance.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

  • Proven experience scaling Instagram accounts with measurable results.
  • Demonstrated ability to grow accounts by 5K+ followers per month or more through organic strategies.
  • Strong understanding of Instagram algorithms, Reels optimization, virality mechanics, and audience growth tactics.
  • Experience using data and analytics to guide content and growth strategy.
  • Comfortable leveraging AI tools for ideation, research, and content production workflows.
  • Highly organized with strong execution and performance tracking skills.

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience managing high-growth or influencer-level social media accounts.
  • Experience with A/B testing content strategies and viral content frameworks.
  • Background in multimedia content production or creative direction.
  • Strong collaboration and communication skills when working with creative teams.

Personality:

  • Analytical and data-driven mindset.
  • Creative strategist with a strong understanding of viral content mechanics.
  • Highly proactive and results-oriented.
  • Adaptable and comfortable working in a fast-growth digital environment.

Software & Tools:

  • Instagram analytics and social media scheduling platforms.
  • AI content generation tools.
  • Performance tracking and analytics tools.

Schedule:

9-5 EST

Compensation & Benefits:

  • Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

title: Data Scientist
description:
Required Skills & Experience


• 5–6+ years of experience as a Data Scientist • 1–2 years of hands-on experience with Generative AI, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and Large Language Models (LLMs) • Strong Python skills, with the ability to integrate code into existing engineering frameworks and hand off to engineering for production deployment • Proficiency with GitHub and version control workflows • Experience with database structures and cloud computing (any provider is acceptable)


Nice to Have Skills & Experience


• Prior working experience with LangGraph


Job Description


You’ll work closely with two Principal Data Scientists and own a feature within a broader education technology initiative. Your tasks will be assigned via Jira by a project manager, and you’ll collaborate with engineering to push code into production. While you won’t be responsible for defining features, you’ll execute on them independently, relying on the Principal Data Scientist for guidance and feedback. Expect 1–2 scrums per week, formal data process reviews (but no formal code reviews), and a fast-paced environment focused on delivering RAG-based AI solutions that support clients.

title: Advogado(a) Pleno | Contencioso Cível
description:
Aqui, você não é apenas um número. Você é protagonista.


Atribuímos à lealdade e à parceria os nossos valores mais intrínsecos. Estamos de peito aberto para escutar e construir um resultado coletivo, integrado entre os nossos profissionais e os nossos clientes.


Somos um escritório de advocacia preparado para entender, no detalhe, as necessidades de cada caso, comunicando-se sempre da forma mais clara e inteligível.


Como um escritório abrangente e altamente qualificado , proporcionamos soluções jurídico estratégicas por meio de uma equipe experiente e informada, movida pela atitude de facilitar as vias das soluções jurídicas, com base em informações completas e seguras das tradicionais até as mais inovadoras.


Queremos e conseguimos ser uma extensão estratégica dos nossos clientes, oferecendo as soluções eficientes e duradouras, adaptadas para cada individualidade.


Juntos, nós seguimos na direção de um caminho justo e coerente.


Cargo: Advogado(a) Pleno em Contencioso Cível


Missão do Cargo:

Atuar em casos litigiosos de forma técnica e eficiente, garantindo que os clientes recebam orientação jurídica clara e suporte confiável, contribuindo para a solução dos processos e para a estratégia do escritório.


Responsabilidades e Atribuições:


  • Atuação em casos litigiosos no geral, com exposição a diferentes áreas do contencioso, incluindo família e sucessões.
  • Reuniões com clientes para esclarecimento de dúvidas e alinhamento de estratégias.
  • Elaboração de peças processuais e acompanhamento do andamento dos processos, garantindo qualidade técnica e cumprimento de prazos.
  • Diligências presenciais e levantamento de informações junto a órgãos públicos e tribunais.
  • Suporte à equipe na análise de casos e preparação de documentos jurídicos, mantendo comunicação clara com clientes e colegas.


Requisitos:


  • Formação em Direito (registro ativo na OAB).
  • Experiência prévia em contencioso cível.
  • Boa comunicação e relacionamento com clientes.
  • Organização, comprometimento com prazos e atenção a detalhes.
  • Desejável experiência em família e sucessões.


Benefícios:


  • Salário competitivo;
  • Assistência médica;
  • Assistência odontológica;
  • Seguro de vida;
  • Reembolso de atividade física;
  • Estacionamento ou auxílio mobilidade;
  • Plano de desenvolvimento;
  • Bônus.


Regime de Trabalho

  • Modelo híbrido: 4 dias presenciais e 1 dia remoto .

title: DevOps Sênior
description:
A Foursys é um time apaixonado por inovação, design e transformação digital.


Somos globais, somos GPTW.


♿️ Na Foursys, celebramos a diversidade e acreditamos que são as diferentes ideias e perspectivas que nos enriquecem. Portanto, sua cor, religião, gênero, raça, nacionalidade, idade, origem, identidade de gênero, deficiência ou orientação sexual não são barreiras para se juntar à nossa equipe. #VemSerFoursys!

Todas as nossas vagas estão abertas para Pessoas com Deficiência (PCD). Caso você se enquadre ou conheça alguém com o perfil, a Foursys é a empresa ideal!

Que tal se juntar a nós e se tornar um(a) #FourTalent? Então se liga nessa oportunidade incrível:


Principais Responsabilidades

Responsabilidade: Desenvolvedor é responsável por projetar, desenvolver e manter pipelines de CI/CD no Azure DevOps, garantindo processos automatizados e seguros para compilação, teste e entrega de software. Além disso, será responsável pela criação e manutenção de Dockerfiles e imagens de contêiner, assegurando atualizações regulares e correções de vulnerabilidades, e pela criação de templates base para projetos em React e .NET, promovendo padronização, qualidade e eficiência no ciclo de desenvolvimento.Também deverá gerenciar o Azure DevOps, especialmente no uso e configuração do Azure Boards, criando projetos, times e workflows ágeis que suportem o ciclo de desenvolvimento de software da organização.


Requisitos técnicos:

• Azure DevOps (Repos, Pipelines, Artifacts e Boards).

• Criação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD.

• Gerenciamento do Azure Boards (criação de projetos, times, workflows, sprints e dashboards).

• Criação e manutenção de Dockerfiles e imagens base.

• Gestão de vulnerabilidades em containers e imagens.

• Infraestrutura como Código (Terraform, Bicep, ARM).

• Conhecimento em .NET e React.

• Versionamento de código (Git).

• Automação de builds e releases.

• Monitoramento e integração de qualidade de código (SonarQube, CodeQL).

Formato de trabalho: Home office


E temos também o Clube da Four que oferece ótimas vantagens!

title: CRO & Marketing Specialist (UX, Content Writing)
description:
Company Description

We are Charly, a growing digital agency specializing in web design, UX/UI, branding, ecommerce, and development for clients primarily in the US. Our team is spread across Europe and Latin America and we are scaling fast.

We are looking for a Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) Specialist who is passionate about websites, data, and improving performance. This role will focus on analyzing user behavior, identifying conversion bottlenecks, and implementing structured experimentation to improve lead generation and sales performance across our client projects.

You will work closely with our Project Managers, designers, developers, and leadership team to ensure that the websites we build are not only visually strong but also optimized to convert.


Your Core Responsibilities

  • Conduct CRO audits for client websites and landing pages to identify friction points, funnel drop-offs, and conversion barriers
  • Analyze user behavior using tools such as Google Analytics, Tag Manager, heatmaps, and session recordings
  • Identify issues related to checkout abandonment, form drop-offs, mobile UX problems, trust gaps, and messaging clarity
  • Design and implement structured A/B or multivariate experiments to improve conversion performance
  • Optimize key elements including headlines, CTAs, layouts, forms, product pages, and landing pages
  • Prepare structured audit reports with prioritized recommendations based on potential revenue impact
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and PMs to implement CRO improvements across active client projects
  • Join client and sales calls when necessary to explain CRO strategies, findings, and experiment results in clear, non-technical language
  • Continuously refine optimization strategies as new data and experiment results become available


Who this role is perfect for:

  • Someone with strong analytical thinking who can translate data into clear action steps
  • Someone who understands both UX and marketing psychology behind conversions
  • Someone comfortable running experiments and interpreting results
  • Someone who enjoys working with websites, funnels, and digital products
  • Someone proactive who can identify improvement opportunities without waiting for direction
  • Someone comfortable collaborating with designers, developers, and project managers in a remote team environment
  • Someone fluent in English and confident communicating with clients
  • Based in Latin America


What We Offer:

  • Full-time remote role in a growing digital agency
  • Flexible work environment with a distributed international team
  • Opportunity to work on multiple websites and client projects across different industries
  • Direct collaboration with leadership, PMs, designers, and developers
  • Long-term role with the opportunity to shape CRO processes as the agency scales


To Apply:

To apply, send your CV and a 1-minute video introducing yourself and your experience to with the subject line:


\"CRO & Marketing Specialist Application - (Your Full Name)\"


In your video, briefly cover who you are, your marketing and CRO background, and one result or project you are proud of.



⚠️ Applications submitted via LinkedIn will NOT be considered. Please ensure you meet the listed qualifications before applying.

title: Quality Engineer (QE) — Automação- Sênior
description:
Estamos buscando um profissional com sólida experiência em automação e qualidade de software. Procuramos alguém tecnicamente forte em Playwright, testes de front-end e API, e familiarizado com práticas modernas de QA, como shift-left testing e Gherkin.

Se você gosta de evoluir frameworks de automação e contribuir para a cultura de qualidade de múltiplas squads, esta vaga é para você.


Junte-se a um time orientado à inovação, focado em excelência de automação e qualidade, sob a liderança de um Coordenador de Engenharia de QA experiente.


O que você irá fazer:

* Desenvolver, executar e manter testes automatizados (foco em APIs e serviços/microserviços).

* Especificar e implementar cenários seguindo BDD com Gherkin.

* Registrar, organizar e rastrear cenários, evidências e resultados no Xray (Gherkin).

* Garantir cobertura e eficácia com técnicas de teste de caixa preta e caixa branca.

* Integrar automação aos pipelines de CI/CD (ex.: Jenkins), garantindo execução recorrente e confiável.

* Realizar smoke testing e identificar rapidamente falhas críticas.

* Validar fluxos síncronos e assíncronos, incluindo cenários com mensageria (AWS SQS) quando aplicável.

* Colaborar com times de desenvolvimento, produto e operações para qualidade ponta a ponta.

* Utilizar Docker para provisionamento de ambientes de teste e execução de pipelines automatizados.

* Apoiar investigação de falhas utilizando observabilidade (traces/métricas/logs), quando necessário.


O que esperamos de você:

* Experiência sólida com Playwright (automação).

* Experiência com Gherkin (BDD) e uso do Xray com Gherkin.

* Profundo entendimento de APIs (validação de payloads, autenticação, contratos, timeouts, retries, etc.).

* Experiência com CI/CD e integração de testes em pipelines (ex.: Jenkins).

* Conhecimento em Docker e ambientes conteinerizados.

* Familiaridade com testes em ambientes distribuídos / microserviços.

* Domínio de técnicas de teste de caixa preta e caixa branca.

* Vivência com smoke testing.

* Programação (principalmente JavaScript) — obrigatório e eliminatório.


Desejável:

* Experiência com validação de fluxos assíncronos e tópicos de mensageria (SQS/DLQ/reprocessamento).

* Noções de Kubernetes/EKS para troubleshooting básico de execuções (logs/health checks).

* Experiência com observabilidade (Dynatrace / OpenTelemetry / Grafana Loki) para diagnóstico e redução de testes instáveis (“flaky tests”).

* Experiência com testes de performance e segurança.

* Conhecimento em cloud (AWS, Azure ou GCP).

* Noções de Terraform (para entendimento de ambientes e limitações de infraestrutura).



A OSF Digital tem orgulho de ser uma empresa que oferece oportunidades iguais, onde você pode ser você mesmo no trabalho. Junte-se a uma comunidade inclusiva e apaixonada de profissionais que ajudam a promover a transformação digital para empresas ao redor do mundo. Na OSF Digital, acolhemos todas as pessoas e não discriminamos com base em identidade e expressão de gênero, raça, etnia, deficiência, orientação sexual, cor, religião, origem nacional, idade, estado civil ou qualquer outra categoria protegida em qualquer jurisdição onde atuamos.

title: SAP FI (Inglês Avançado)
description:
SAP FI Specialist


Summary: Support and enhance Lubrizol Global SAP Procure to Pay (PTP) and Record to Report (RTR) process as a specialist,

with a primary focus on Procurement, Finance, Cost, Tax, and Localization solutions for Brazil and Mexico. Experience with CO.

Leverage deep knowledge of procurement and financial operations, tax calculation and compliance reporting within the Brazilian and Mexican legislative environments.

Engage with business stakeholders across the globe to ensure alignment and support across strategic priorities, technical domains, and standardized practices globally while ensuring that local and regional requirements are met.

Responsibilities:

Analyze, configure, test,deploy, and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions focused on PTP and RTR, especially as they relate to Procurement,

Finance, and Tax processes for Brazil and Mexico (including Nota Fiscal, CFDI, SPED, and related regulatory reporting).

Make recommendations for improving business processes and technology enablement, particularly around local tax compliance and statutory reporting.

Ensure accurate localization of SAP solutions to comply with Brazilian and Mexican legal and fiscal requirements, including tax calculation engines, e invoicing, and withholding tax management.

Develop standard business process design, configure, test, deploy and support SAP ECC and S/4 HANA solutions along with any bolt on for all procurement processes.

Effectively communicate and collaborate with Procurement, Finance, Tax, IT Business Partners, and Senior Leadership, as well as with other business stakeholders.

Resolve integration points between RTR, Procure to Pay (PTP), Order to Cash (OTC), and Treasury processes to ensure they are properly addressed.

Support daily operations for SAP Procurement, Finance, and Tax processes, including issue resolution, user support, and change management.

Makes decisions applicable to level of influence in the organization. Collaborate with cross functional teams to align local tax and statutory requirements with global standard processes.

Utilize technical and functional expertise to support Procurement, Finance, and Tax initiatives.

Participate in or lead projects implementing or upgrading, tax localization, and compliance solutions.


Horario de trabalho: Comercial

Trabalho: Remoto

title: Senior Backend Engineer (Python/Django)

Salary & Benefits

  • Salary : $4,000 – $4,500 USD per month (depending on experience and location)
  • Benefits : 15 Days Paid Time Off + Christmas Day + New Year's Day Paid Off
Our Recruitment Process
  • Initial screening call with our recruitment team
  • Technical assessment to showcase your skills (if applicable)
  • Final interview with our Hiring Manager
  • Offer extended
Life at Search Atlas Group

We are committed to fostering a healthy work-life balance, innovation, and a collaborative, inclusive culture—no matter where you work. We host monthly virtual game days and events, and our team enjoys the flexibility of contributing to charity initiatives of their choice. We believe in supporting both personal growth and professional success, ensuring that remote work doesn’t mean disconnected work.

Here’s a look into our core values:

  • Collaborative & Engaged : We’re a tight-knit team that supports each other and shares knowledge.
  • Excellence Driven : We aim for the highest standards, always raising the bar.
  • Self-Starter Mentality : We take initiative and problem-solve independently.
  • Innovative : We embrace change, experiment, and think outside the box.
  • Student Mentality : We learn from our mistakes and constantly evolve.
Why Join Us?

We’re proud of the recognition we’ve received for our growth and commitment to creating a positive, inclusive work environment. Here are just a few of the accolades that highlight our success and culture:

  • Nevada’s Top Workplaces - #1 Small Business (Under 150 Employees), Best New Ideas
  • Best Start-Up Agency (U.S. Search Awards)
  • Top B2B Companies (Clutch)
  • Inc’s On The Rise and Best Places to Work (Inc. Magazine)
  • Great Place to Work Certified (Great Place to Work)


These awards reflect the hard work, dedication, and passion of our entire team, and we’d love for you to be a part of it!

Want to hear more? Here’s our Founder, Manick, on why you should work with us at Search Atlas.

title: OpenText Consultant
description:
OpenText VIM/OCR Expert - Remote working - English Speaking


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the design and implementation of OpenText VIM for automated vendor invoice processing.
  • Configure and support invoice capture, OCR extraction, validation, workflow routing, and posting to SAP FI/MM .
  • Implement and optimize OpenText Intelligent Capture Center (ICC) or equivalent OCR tools for invoice data extraction.
  • Configure VIM Document Processing (DP), exception handling, and workflow approvals .
  • Integrate VIM with SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable, PO invoice processing, and vendor master data .

  • Troubleshoot issues related to OCR extraction, invoice matching, workflow processing, and FI posting errors .
  • Support go-live and hypercare activities, including improving touchless invoice processing rates.

title: English Teacher
description:
Are you a Portuguese speaker who graduated as an English Teacher? We are looking for you!

Teach fun English classes online via Zoom from the comfort of your own home! You can set your own hours and teach on the go as long as you have a solid color backdrop, a laptop, good WiFi, a webcam, and a microphone.


If you love teaching, but dread prepping for lessons and grading, this is the perfect job for you. We provide our teachers with all the lesson materials so all you have to do is show up for class and do what you do best, which is teach!

Whether you’re looking for a second stream of income or a full-time job, we’ve got you covered. You can work as little as 16 hours a month up to as much as 30 hours a week.


What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Parceiro de vendas
description:
Seja um Parceiro Estratégico do Grupo AG Capital, a Primeira TaxTech do Brasil.


Você é um consultor, comercial ou líder de negócios com acesso a decisores C-level?

Quer oferecer aos seus clientes uma solução de alto impacto, sem custo inicial, e ainda gerar uma nova e significativa fonte de receita?

O Grupo AG Capital, a primeira e maior TaxTech do Brasil, está expandindo sua rede de Parceiros Estratégicos. Já recuperamos mais de R$ 8 bilhões em tributos para mais de 12.000 clientes, incluindo 15% das empresas listadas na B3, e queremos que você faça parte desta história de sucesso.

Nossa missão é transformar a complexidade tributária brasileira em fluxo de caixa e compliance para as empresas, através de tecnologia proprietária e uma metodologia exclusiva. Para acelerar essa missão, buscamos parceiros que compartilhem da nossa visão e queiram crescer conosco.


Quem Buscamos? O Parceiro Ideal em 3 Dimensões:


1) Expertise e Acesso a Clientes Estratégicos:


Você é um especialista com reputação sólida em consultoria (contábil, tributária, RH), advocacia empresarial, tecnologia ou vendas; Possui um relacionamento de confiança com CFOs, CHROs e CEOs de médias e grandes empresas, especialmente as de Lucro Presumido ou Real? Buscamos sua credibilidade e seu acesso ao mercado.


2) Alinhamento com um Modelo de Negócio Inovador:


Você acredita em um modelo onde o cliente só paga pelo sucesso, sem custos de entrada ou taxas de manutenção?

Nosso modelo de remuneração 100% no êxito é um dos nossos maiores diferenciais. Buscamos parceiros que saibam comunicar o poder de uma proposta de valor de risco zero.


3) Mentalidade \"TaxTech\"


Você vê a tecnologia como o futuro da gestão fiscal? Com nossa plataforma proprietária Athena™, analisamos 100% dos dados fiscais sem amostragem, garantindo precisão e escala incomparáveis. Buscamos parceiros que queiram liderar a transformação digital no setor tributário.


O que Oferecemos à sua Parceria:


•Portfólio de Alto Valor: Adicione as soluções AG, AG Tax e Agnes ao seu portfólio e resolva dores latentes de seus clientes.

•Modelo de Receita Atrativo: Gere uma nova e robusta linha de receita, 100% comissionada sobre o sucesso das operações, sem limite de ganhos.

•Força da Marca Líder: Associe-se à marca que é referência no mercado, com metodologia validada, operação segurada pela Berkley e reconhecimento pela mídia e por grandes premiações (Exame, Deloitte, BTG Pactual).

•Diferencial Competitivo: Ofereça aos seus clientes uma solução inovadora que a concorrência não possui, fortalecendo seu próprio posicionamento como consultor estratégico.


Você se identifica com este perfil?


Se você é um profissional visionário, com uma carteira de clientes consolidada e o desejo de gerar um impacto financeiro real para seus clientes e para o seu negócio, queremos conversar com você.

Aqui, cada profissional é acompanhado, cada cliente é ouvido e cada entrega tem propósito.

Nossa cultura é baseada em transparência, colaboração e inovação. Valorizamos a autonomia e o desenvolvimento contínuo de nossos talentos.

Você se identifica com esse propósito? Então, o seu futuro é na Prezensa.

  • Dinamismo;

  • Objetividade e clareza na exposição de ideias para o time;

  • Parceria com a Open English e Cellep para aprimoramento do inglês;
  • Oportunidade de realizar cursos e certificações;
  • Apoio para participação em eventos de TI;
  • Acesso a serviços de saúde e bem-estar através da nossa parceria com a Wellhub;
  • Acesso à Onhappy, plataforma exclusiva que oferece descontos em passagens aéreas e hospedagens.

description:

Brazil

Software Engineer Lead

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a Tech Lead FullStack developer you will work with a multidisciplinary team to support building integrations, maintaining and improving existing code. You will work in a very dynamic environment with a lot of interaction with the product team to gather requirements and get tasks more refined.

  • Experience with JavaScript (frontend), JSON;

Highly Desirable Skills

What is a typical day for an Online English Teacher at LatinHire?

You will be scheduled shifts two weeks in advance according to the availability you provide us and we also offer the flexibility of dropping shifts and picking up extra shifts.

If you are busier one week, you can drop some of your shifts and have other teachers help you out or if you want to earn more $$ another week, you can pick up extra shifts and help other teachers out.

When you are on shift, you log on to our platform and teach the lessons provided as well as write short feedback for the students after class. Simple as that!


In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with LatinHire:


  • Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week!
  • You be your own boss and set your own schedule
  • Work from anywhere (as long as you have good WiFi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone).
  • Depending on the number of hours you decide to teach and on your schedule, you can earn up to USD 900+ per month.


Minimum Requirements:


  • Portuguese as a first language.
  • C1 or C2 Level English Speaker
  • University degree in English Teaching or related area.
  • One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language.
  • Access to a computer with a reliable, high-speed (at least 2MB) internet connection.
  • Must pass a criminal background check.
  • Teachers must provide at least ten (10) hours of weekly availability.


Who we are:

Established in 2003, LatinHire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.

title: Business Development Manager (BDM) - FOREX BROKERAGE
description:
Disruptive Talents, a boutique headhunting and strategic recruitment firm, is collaborating with an international Forex brokerage to identify a Business Development Manager (BDM) – Brazil.


At Disruptive Talents, we connect commercially driven talent with high-growth financial services organizations. This search is conducted on behalf of an international Forex brokerage seeking to accelerate client acquisition, strategic partnerships, and revenue growth across the Brazilian and Latin American markets.


This is a strategic opportunity to join the commercial growth team at a critical stage of the company’s expansion in Brazil, playing a central role in developing client relationships, strategic partnerships, and long-term revenue growth in the local market.


About the Company


A regulated international Forex brokerage operating across multiple jurisdictions, the company provides trading access and infrastructure solutions to professional traders, institutional clients, introducing brokers (IBs), asset managers, and strategic partners. With a growing global footprint and a strong emphasis on technology, compliance, and scalable brokerage solutions, the firm continues to expand its presence in key regional markets, including Colombia, Mexico and Brazil.


As a Business Development Manager, you will focus on expanding the company’s footprint among professional traders, institutional clients, introducing brokers (IBs), asset managers, and strategic partners.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of financial markets, brokerage products, and client trading needs, paired with a consultative, relationship-led sales approach.


What You Will Do:


Business Growth & Revenue

  • Identify, develop, and close new business opportunities across FX, CFDs, equities, derivatives, or multi-asset trading solutions.
  • Drive revenue growth through direct client acquisition and strategic partnerships (IBs, affiliates, money managers).
  • Own the full sales cycle: prospecting, pitching, negotiation, onboarding coordination, and account growth.
  • Achieve and exceed individual and team revenue targets.


Client & Partner Management

  • Build long-term relationships with professional traders, institutional clients, and high-value partners.
  • Act as a trusted commercial advisor, aligning client trading needs with platform capabilities, pricing, and liquidity solutions.
  • Support retention and account expansion by identifying cross-sell and upsell opportunities.


Market & Industry Intelligence

  • Stay current on global financial market trends, trading technologies, and competitor offerings.
  • Monitor regulatory developments (e.g., MiFID II, FCA, CySEC, ASIC) and ensure commercial activity aligns with compliance requirements.
  • Represent the company at industry events, conferences, and client meetings.


Internal Collaboration

  • Work closely with trading, liquidity, risk, compliance, and operations teams to ensure seamless client onboarding and service delivery.
  • Partner with marketing to support lead-generation campaigns and regional growth initiatives.
  • Maintain accurate pipeline management, forecasts, and performance reporting via CRM tools.


What We Are Looking For:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business, or a related field.
  • 3–7+ years of business development, sales, or relationship management experience within financial markets brokerage (FX, CFDs, equities, crypto, or derivatives).
  • Strong understanding of trading platforms, brokerage revenue models, and client acquisition channels.
  • Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Deep interest in financial markets and trading products.
  • Strong negotiation and closing skills.
  • Relationship-driven, consultative sales mindset.
  • Excellent communication and presentation abilities.
  • Highly organized, data-driven, and comfortable working with CRM and reporting tools.


What We Offer:

  • Competitive base salary plus performance-based commission.
  • Exposure to global financial markets and high-value clients.
  • Clear career progression in a fast-growing brokerage environment.
  • Collaborative, performance-oriented culture.


How to Apply:

  • If you thrive in fast-moving financial markets and enjoy building profitable, long-term client relationships, we’d love to hear from you

title: Customer Success Associate
description:
About AdManage.ai Type: Full-Time We're building the Cursor for ad management.

AdManage.ai helps companies launch ads 10x faster on Meta & TikTok. Created by top performance marketers who've managed over $50M+ in ad spend, our mission is to level the playing field by giving every business access to enterprise-grade ad automation tools.

Our platform launches 900,000+ ads per month, saving advertisers hours with bulk ad creation, creative mining, and AI-powered campaign tools. We're profitable, fast-moving, and backed by experience — not just ideas.


The Mission Our users are ambitious brands and agencies who rely on us not just for software, but for expertise that helps them scale profitably. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Junior Customer Success Manager with a media buying background who can bridge the gap between software and performance marketing. You'll ensure our customers get real outcomes with AdManage.ai — not just features. You'll be supported by a strong CS team and learn fast.


What You'll Do

  • Support onboarding: help guide new customers from setup to first wins alongside senior team members.
  • Be a go-to resource: use your media buying knowledge to answer questions on campaign structure, creative testing, and platform features.
  • Drive adoption: help customers unlock the full value of features like bulk ad launching, creative mining, and performance dashboards.
  • Build relationships: be a reliable, friendly point of contact for brands, agencies, and growth teams.
  • Close the feedback loop: surface customer pain points to our product and engineering teams. We ship continuously — your insights will hit production fast.
  • Help reduce churn: flag at-risk accounts early and work with the team to find solutions.


What We're Looking For

  • At least 6 months of experience in a customer-facing role (CSM, account management, support, or similar in a SaaS company).
  • Strong communication skills — you're confident on Google Meet, email, and Slack.
  • Comfortable using AI tools in your day-to-day workflow, including Claude Code for automating repetitive tasks, drafting customer communications, or building lightweight internal tools.
  • Startup mentality: eager to learn, comfortable with ambiguity, and happy to wear multiple hats.
  • Curiosity, empathy, and a bias for action are non-negotiable.

Bonus Points For

  • Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager or TikTok Ads at a campaign level
  • Any exposure to SaaS tools or ad tech platforms
  • Experience using Claude Code or similar agentic AI tools to automate workflows
  • Prior internship or junior role at a startup or agency
  • Some hands-on experience with paid social (Meta, TikTok) — whether through internships, agency work, freelance, or running your own campaigns.


Why Join Us

  • Join an amazing Customer Success team and grow fast.
  • Direct impact: your feedback shapes our product roadmap from day one.
  • Work alongside founders who've scaled brands like ZOE, Photoroom, and Nextdoor.


How to Apply Send your LinkedIn and 2–3 lines on: What's a performance marketing challenge you've helped solve — or one you're fascinated by? Bonus: any results or campaigns you're proud of, however small.

title: Ruby on Rails Developer
description:
Senior Software Engineer I, L3 Messaging Team (Remote)

We're recruiting a Senior Software Engineer I to own the technical direction of a mission-critical messaging platform serving hundreds of healthcare organizations across the United States.


THE ROLE

Our client is a fast-growing, mission-driven organization transforming patient engagement at scale. They've built the leading platform powering communications for underserved populations, with proven impact reaching millions. Now they're looking for a seasoned backend engineer to lead their Messaging Team technical direction and mentor the next generation of engineering talent.


You'll own complex features end-to-end, drive architectural decisions that shape how millions of patient communications are delivered, and share team lead responsibilities with your peers. This is a highly visible, technically autonomous role with direct impact on health equity outcomes.


WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

  • 5+ years hands-on backend engineering with Ruby on Rails at scale
  • Deep experience building, maintaining, and scaling APIs and distributed systems
  • Advanced SQL skills and comfort working with large, complex datasets
  • Proven ability to independently own complex projects end-to-end and mentor junior engineers
  • Data-driven mindset you rely on evidence, not intuition
  • Excellent communicator (especially in fully remote environments)
  • Passionate about mission-driven work and advancing health equity


BONUS POINTS

  • Experience with Twilio, RCS, or MMS messaging platforms
  • Familiarity with healthcare compliance (TCPA, consent workflows, carrier regulations)
  • Tech stack: React, PostgreSQL, Google Cloud, Sidekiq
  • Event-driven architecture or high-throughput message delivery pipelines


WHAT YOU'LL DO

  • Own and drive the technical direction of key messaging platform features
  • Design and build backend messaging systems (delivery pipelines, consent management, scheduling orchestration, API integrations)
  • Mentor L2 engineers, lead technical design discussions, and set engineering standards
  • Contribute to architectural decisions that shape messaging infrastructure at scale
  • Participate in on-call rotations (PagerDuty) and help improve team processes
  • Work cross-functionally with Product, Customer Success, and Data teams


YOUR IMPACT

  • Month 1: Master the platform architecture and contribute to technical design discussions
  • Month 3: Independently deliver complex features with meaningful impact on patient outcomes
  • Month 6: Be recognized as a technical leader driving strategic initiatives across the engineering department

title: Product Manager Sênior - Planejamento Comercial
description:
Sobre a posição no jogo

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Product Manager Sênior para liderar a evolução das soluções de Planejamento Comercial , atuando na interseção entre negócio, dados e tecnologia.

Essa posição tem como missão maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos, conectando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado e ao planejamento de compras , garantindo decisões orientadas por dados, menor time-to-market e melhor alocação de capital em estoque.

Você será responsável por transformar dores do time comercial (Buying & Planning) em produtos digitais escaláveis, garantindo adoção real, automação e impacto direto em KPIs críticos do negócio.


Missão da Área

Maximizar a rentabilidade e a eficiência do portfólio de produtos através da tecnologia, integrando o ciclo de vida do produto (PLM) à inteligência de mercado, para suportar decisões de compra e sortimento orientadas por dados, com maior agilidade e menor risco.


Objetivos estratégicos do produto

  • Digitalização do ciclo de vida do Produto;
  • Implementar e evoluir a plataforma de PLM, centralizando o desenvolvimento desde o conceito até a ficha técnica final;
  • Inteligência de Compra e Planejamento;
  • Criar ou integrar soluções que automatizem o cálculo de OTB (Open to Buy) e recomendem sortimento ideal por canal, região e perfil de demanda.
  • Conexão com o Mercado;
  • Traduzir tendências, dados de concorrência e sinais de mercado em parâmetros técnicos para o desenvolvimento e planejamento de novos produtos;
  • Eficiência Operacional;
  • Reduzir rupturas, excessos de estoque e markdowns por meio de previsões de demanda, planejamento integrado e automação de processos.


Responsabilidades

  • Definir e liderar a visão e estratégia do produto de Planejamento Comercial , alinhando tecnologia às necessidades do negócio;
  • Gerenciar a evolução contínua das ferramentas de PLM e Planning , garantindo estabilidade, escalabilidade e adoção;
  • Atuar como braço tecnológico do time comercial , conduzindo discovery com compradores, planejadores e áreas correlatas;
  • Traduzir dores de negócio em soluções digitais, processos otimizados e integrações sistêmicas ;
  • Garantir a arquitetura e integridade dos dados de produto , do nascimento no PLM até a venda no PDV e e-commerce;
  • Avaliar e conduzir decisões de Build vs. Buy , considerando custo, tempo, escalabilidade e aderência ao negócio;
  • Priorizar roadmap e backlog com base em impacto em rentabilidade, eficiência operacional e risco de estoque ;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Engenharia, Dados, SAP e fornecedores externos;
  • Garantir que o plano de compras aprovado seja convertido em pedidos automatizados (PO) no SAP , com mínima intervenção manual;
  • Monitorar e comunicar resultados por meio de KPIs claros e orientados a impacto .


Escopo Tecnológico

Você atuará diretamente na evolução e integração dos seguintes pilares:

  • PLM (Product Lifecycle Management)
  • Desenvolvimento de produtos, fornecedores, custos, ciclo de vida e cadastros.
  • Demand Planning & Analytics
  • Modelagem de dados e algoritmos para suporte ao planejamento de compras.
  • Market Intelligence Hub
  • Integração de APIs e dados externos de mercado e concorrência.
  • ERP (SAP – MM / Retail)
  • Integração robusta para automação do ciclo de compra, pedidos e cadastros.
  • Automação do Planejamento para Pedido
  • Conversão de planejamento em Pedidos de Compra (PO) automáticos
  • Sincronização de mestres (materiais e fornecedores)
  • Monitoramento de status de recebimento e notas fiscais


Requisitos Obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida como Product Manager Sênior em contextos de varejo, indústria ou operações comerciais complexas ;
  • Conhecimento profundo do ciclo de vida do produto (PLM, Buying, Planning, Supply) ;
  • Experiência atuando com sistemas corporativos e integrações (ex.: ERP, PLM, Planning);
  • Forte capacidade analítica, com uso de dados para tomada de decisão ;
  • Vivência em discovery com áreas não-digitais (ex.: Comercial, Compras, Planejamento);
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis ;
  • Comunicação clara, estruturada e habilidade em negociação de prioridades com múltiplos stakeholders .


Diferenciais Desejáveis

  • Experiência prévia com SAP MM ou SAP Retail ;
  • Conhecimento em OTB (Open to Buy) , planejamento de sortimento e previsão de demanda;
  • Domínio de SQL, Power BI ou ferramentas analíticas similares ;
  • Experiência em decisões de Build vs. Buy e gestão de fornecedores de software;
  • Atuação em ambientes de transformação digital de áreas comerciais .


O que define sucesso nessa posição

  • Redução do lead time do ciclo de desenvolvimento de produtos (briefing → venda);
  • Alta taxa de adoção das ferramentas pelo time de Compras e Planejamento;
  • Crescimento do percentual de pedidos automatizados (Zero-Touch PO) ;
  • Melhor aderência ao OTB planejado ;
  • Redução de markdowns e maior venda a preço cheio.


Por que essa vaga é especial?

Porque você vai liderar um produto que atua no coração da decisão comercial da empresa , conectando estratégia, dados e execução.

Aqui, decisões de produto impactam diretamente margem, capital investido em estoque e velocidade de reação ao mercado . É uma posição para quem gosta de complexidade real , influência transversal e impacto mensurável no resultado do negócio.

Bora movimentar o esporte.

title: Especialista em Customer Success / Account Manager
description:
Nós, da Knewin , somos líderes na América Latina quando se trata de ajudar empresas e marcas a gerenciar sua reputação e presença online através de análises de dados. Com mais de 2000 clientes , nosso objetivo é conectar nossos parceiros com seu público-alvo, visando conquistar sua preferência e alcançar resultados excepcionais para seus negócios. Valorizamos uma cultura que prioriza a agilidade, a flexibilidade e a satisfação do cliente, enquanto acreditamos no potencial transformador da tecnologia, do conhecimento e, principalmente, das pessoas.


Buscamos uma pessoa Especialista em Customer Success / Account Manager para atuar como guardiã da experiência de nossos clientes, garantindo impacto real nos resultados e expansão sustentável da carteira. Você será responsável por conduzir relacionamentos estratégicos, conectar problemas de negócio às soluções da Knewin e atuar como principal voz do cliente internamente.


É uma posição que combina visão analítica, capacidade consultiva e uma execução disciplinada — sustentada por relações de confiança, foco em metas e busca contínua por excelência.


Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Gerir uma carteira de clientes estratégicos, garantindo retenção, expansão e geração de valor contínuo;
  • Relacionar-se com grandes empresas e stakeholders seniores
  • Entender necessidades de negócio e traduzir em soluções práticas, construindo e conduzindo planos de sucesso (Success Plans) com metas claras, indicadores e rituais de acompanhamento;
  • Atuar proativamente para prevenir churn com base em dados, comportamento de uso e sinais de risco.


Relacionamento Consultivo

  • Conduzir reuniões presenciais e apresentações executivas
  • Atuar como ponto focal entre cliente e times internos, sendo a principal referência do cliente dentro da Knewin, traduzindo necessidades em soluções;
  • Facilitar a adoção de produtos e orientar sobre melhores práticas;
  • Conduzir rituais executivos (QBRs/EBRs), apresentando resultados e roadmap de evolução.


Operação & Execução

  • Acompanhar métricas-chave como NRR, GRR, churn, engajamento e Earned Growth (NPS+);
  • Registrar interações, status e oportunidades no CRM com precisão e disciplina;
  • Trabalhar em parceria com Produtos, Suporte, Dados e Comercial para resolução de problemas, ativação de melhorias e identificação de oportunidades.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Vivência prévia em Customer Success, Account Management, Consultoria, Projetos ou áreas correlatas;
  • Capacidade de realizar gestão de carteira com organização, priorização e disciplina;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e orientada a solução;
  • Conhecimento de métricas SaaS (MRR, churn, NRR, expansão, adoção);
  • Vivência com ferramentas como CRM (HubSpot/Salesforce), planilhas e plataformas de suporte;
  • Disponibilidade e habilidade para conduzir reuniões presenciais com C-level
  • Residir na cidade de São Paulo ou municípios vizinhos .


Desejáveis

  • Experiência com produtos SaaS B2B;
  • Vivência em análise de dados ou uso de dashboards;
  • Experiência em atendimento a clientes enterprise/governo/corporativo;
  • Conhecimento em NPS, Customer Journey e metodologias de CS (ex.: WbD, Success Playbooks).


Diferenciais

  • Atuação prévia em empresas com foco em reputação, comunicação, PRTech ou martech;
  • Familiaridade com metodologias de consultoria (McKinsey, Bain, BCG);
  • Experiência com processos de expansão e cross-sell;
  • Histórico de alta performance em ambientes com metas arrojadas;
  • Participação na construção de processos, playbooks ou CS Ops;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar em ambientes de transformação e crescimento acelerado.


Cultura de Cliente

  • Atuar com comunicação clara, cumprimento de combinados e foco em experiência (clientes parceiros);
  • Contribuir para uma operação ágil, simples e baseada em dados (planos efetivos);
  • Colaborar com times internos para garantir entregas confiáveis e melhorar processos continuamente.

title: IT Risk Management Lead
description:
IT Risk Management Lead


Comcentia is seeking an experienced IT Risk Management Lead to drive the design, build‑out, and continuous improvement of our client’s enterprise IT Risk Management Program. This role leads the development of risk intake processes, assessment methodologies, and quantitative models aligned with NIST‑based frameworks and the organization’s ISMS.


You’ll partner with Cybersecurity, IT, business stakeholders, and risk owners to identify, assess, document, and monitor technology risks across the enterprise. The Lead serves as the primary SME for IT risk, producing executive‑ready reporting, maturing risk metrics and dashboards, and ensuring treatment plans are well‑defined, tracked, and executed.


Key Responsibilities:

• Lead structured IT risk assessments and apply quantitative scoring models

• Enhance risk intake processes, assessment tools, and framework alignment

• Maintain the enterprise risk register and map risks to SCF‑aligned controls

• Drive treatment planning, cross‑functional coordination, and lifecycle tracking

• Deliver risk reporting, dashboards, and decision‑ready materials for leadership

• Support governance cycles, audit readiness, and GRC tooling adoption

• Champion automation and AI‑enabled workflows to improve program efficiency


Qualifications:

• 7+ years in IT Risk Management, ISMS, or Cybersecurity

• Strong English proficiency (TOEFL Score: 90+ ) required

• Experience leading enterprise risk programs—not just contributing to them

• Strong knowledge of ISO 27001, NIST CSF , SOC 2 , PCI, GDPR

• Hands‑on experience with GRC platforms and risk assessment methodologies

• Excellent communication skills for both technical and executive audiences

• Preferred certifications: ISO 27001 Lead Implementer/Auditor, CISA, CISSP, CISM, SCF Practitioner

title: Content Operations Specialist
description:
Must Apply Online. Use Form below.


Company Description


Sofia Health is a U.S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.

We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, LinkedIn, social media, and podcast channels .


Role Description


The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.


This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.


The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.


What You Will Do


Content & Provider Curation

  • Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
  • Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
  • Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
  • Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities

Cross-Channel Content Management

  • Plan and coordinate content across:
  • Email marketing
  • Blog
  • LinkedIn
  • Social media
  • Podcast promotions
  • Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
  • Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces

Podcast & Media Coordination

  • Manage podcast promotion workflows, including:
  • Episode launch coordination
  • Provider or guest features
  • Cross-posting to email, blog, and social channels
  • Ensure podcast content is repurposed and distributed consistently

Coordination & Execution Flow

  • Create clear content briefs, lineups, and timelines for:
  • Email upload and formatting support
  • Social scheduling support
  • Podcast and blog publishing
  • Manage handoffs between team members to ensure timely publication
  • Review scheduled content for accuracy, completeness, and coverage

Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking

  • Monitor inbound interest generated from content
  • Flag provider-related leads and opportunities for follow-up
  • Track engagement and performance across channels
  • Identify patterns in what drives clicks, inquiries, and bookings


Who You Are

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable managing content across multiple channels at scale
  • Strong written English (professional working proficiency)
  • Process-driven and systems-oriented
  • Able to prioritize independently and manage recurring workflows
  • Clear communicator who keeps work moving across teams


Qualifications

  • Content development and management skills, including the ability to write, edit, and optimize engaging and impactful content
  • Proficiency in content strategy and workflow management, as well as experience with content management systems (CMS)
  • Strong analytical skills with an ability to interpret data and apply insights to enhance content performance
  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, and product teams
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with an ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of SEO, digital marketing principles, and content optimization best practices
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field
  • Experience in the health or wellness industry is highly desirable

About Sphise Technologies


Sphise Technologies is a global outsourcing and talent solutions company, partnering with high-growth businesses to build strong, high-impact teams across finance, technology, and operations. Our trusted technology partner is scaling its operational systems ecosystem and is seeking a Business Systems Administrator to support the stability, integration, and growth of its core business platforms. As the organisation expands, this role will play a key part in ensuring systems remain reliable, integrated, and optimised while supporting AI-enabled workflows and operational efficiency.



Position Overview


We are seeking an experienced Business Systems Administrator to support the daily operation, optimization, and expansion of core business systems. This contractor role will serve as a central technical and strategic partner to Business Operations, ensuring that the organization’s systems ecosystem remains stable, integrated, scalable, and capable of supporting future growth. This role requires experience managing multiple interconnected platforms, building integrations and APIs, and implementing automation and AI-powered solutions that improve operational efficiency and decision-making. Core systems include platforms such as HubSpot, Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , and other operational and revenue tools.




What You'll Do:


  • Manage the day-to-day administration and performance of core business systems
  • Maintain system access, permissions, and overall platform reliability
  • Build and maintain integrations and APIs across CRM, revenue, and operational systems
  • Troubleshoot system issues and ensure reliable data flow between platforms
  • Support the implementation of automation and AI-powered workflows
  • Assist with onboarding and rollout of new tools and platforms
  • Ensure data accuracy, governance, and reporting across systems
  • Partner with internal teams to improve processes and system efficiency.



What You Bring:


  • 3+ years of experience managing business systems in a SaaS or high-growth environment
  • Strong experience administering CRM and revenue platforms (HubSpot required)
  • Proven experience building and managing APIs and system integrations
  • Experience working with multi-system ecosystems
  • Hands-on experience implementing automation or AI-enabled tools
  • Strong systems thinking and architectural mindset
  • Excellent troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
  • High attention to detail and focus on data integrity
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills
  • Ability to translate business needs into technical solutions.



Nice to Have

  • Experience with Gong, Maxio, Arrows, ZoomInfo , or similar revenue operations tools
  • Familiarity with iPaaS tools such as Zapier, Make, or Workato
  • Experience supporting Customer Success and Revenue Operations teams
  • Background in process optimization and change management
  • Experience working in private equity-backed or rapidly scaling organizations.



What We Offer

  • Competitive compensation
  • Fully remote work environment
  • Opportunity to work with modern SaaS platforms and automation tools
  • High-impact role supporting business operations and systems strategy
  • Collaborative and fast-growing environment with strong ownership.

title: Content Operations Specialist
description:

Company Description


Sofia Health is a U.S.-based wellness technology company and two-sided marketplace connecting people to trusted health and wellness professionals. We support providers with tools for visibility, scheduling, and bookings across therapy, coaching, fitness, nutrition, and integrative health.

We are hiring a Content Operations Manager to own how content and provider visibility are planned, organized, and distributed across email, blog, LinkedIn, social media, and podcast channels .


Role Description


The Content Operations Manager is responsible for managing content operations across all major channels and ensuring providers on the Sofia Health platform are consistently surfaced through structured, repeatable systems.


This role focuses on planning, coordination, prioritization, and execution flow — working with existing content, provider profiles, and internal team members to ensure content moves smoothly from planning to publication.


The role also involves leveraging data and analytics to refine content strategies, driving engagement, and ensuring operational efficiencies in content processes.


What You Will Do


Content & Provider Curation

  • Review and audit provider profiles on the Sofia Health platform
  • Organize providers by modality, topic, availability, and seasonality
  • Maintain a structured rotation system to ensure fair and consistent exposure
  • Select providers and content to feature based on campaigns and priorities

Cross-Channel Content Management

  • Plan and coordinate content across:
  • Email marketing
  • Blog
  • LinkedIn
  • Social media
  • Podcast promotions
  • Build weekly and monthly content plans aligning providers, topics, and channels
  • Ensure content is accurate, current, and aligned across all surfaces

Podcast & Media Coordination

  • Manage podcast promotion workflows, including:
  • Episode launch coordination
  • Provider or guest features
  • Cross-posting to email, blog, and social channels
  • Ensure podcast content is repurposed and distributed consistently

Coordination & Execution Flow

  • Create clear content briefs, lineups, and timelines for:
  • Email upload and formatting support
  • Social scheduling support
  • Podcast and blog publishing
  • Manage handoffs between team members to ensure timely publication
  • Review scheduled content for accuracy, completeness, and coverage

Lead Awareness & Performance Tracking

  • Monitor inbound interest generated from content
  • Flag provider-related leads and opportunities for follow-up
  • Track engagement and performance across channels
  • Identify patterns in what drives clicks, inquiries, and bookings


Who You Are

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented
  • Comfortable managing content across multiple channels at scale
  • Strong written English (professional working proficiency)
  • Process-driven and systems-oriented
  • Able to prioritize independently and manage recurring workflows
  • Clear communicator who keeps work moving across teams


Qualifications

  • Content development and management skills, including the ability to write, edit, and optimize engaging and impactful content
  • Proficiency in content strategy and workflow management, as well as experience with content management systems (CMS)
  • Strong analytical skills with an ability to interpret data and apply insights to enhance content performance
  • Experience in collaborating with cross-functional teams, including marketing, design, and product teams
  • Strong organizational and project management skills, with an ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
  • Knowledge of SEO, digital marketing principles, and content optimization best practices
  • Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Marketing, Journalism, or a related field
  • Experience in the health or wellness industry is highly desirable
